name: code-smell-hunter
description: Systematic code smell detection and precision refactoring for Antigravity. Hunts down Bloaters, OO Abusers, Change Preventers, Dispensables, and Couplers using Martin Fowler recipes and regression-safe subagents.
suggestedPrompts: /smell Audit this file for code smells, classify them by severity, and propose refactoring steps
Identify any God Class or Long Method anti-patterns in our service layer and safely decompose them
Refactor complex nested conditionals into clean guard clauses and strategy pattern without breaking tests
